# boltons typeutils selected-module contract

Type utilities: make_sentinel(name, var_name=None) creates a fresh falsy identity sentinel; shallow/deep copies return the same object. Repr uses var_name when given, otherwise Sentinel(name_repr). A module-level sentinel with matching var_name supports pickling. Each call creates a distinct sentinel. issubclass returns the built-in result for valid classes and False instead of raising TypeError for unsuitable arguments. get_all_subclasses returns distinct transitive subclasses in breadth-first order and rejects non-types. classproperty exposes a read-only class-level getter on class and instance access. See upstream source docstrings for the full selected module contract. SpecGuard authored this specification from upstream documentation.
